laws.rule: The legal age for cannabis in Manitoba is 19. Adults may carry up to 30 g of dried cannabis (or equivalent) in public, and buy only from private licensed stores, in person and online.
Smoking or vaping cannabis is illegal in all public places, including streets, sidewalks, parks, beaches and restaurant patios.
